heading: ### Round-17 gate/probe registry — re-pin and monitor
notes: The pin-disposition TMPDIR exit-2 arm is exercised by the allocating --selftest path only. The normal --manifest/--root probe exits 0 with an unusable TMPDIR because it allocates no scratch (receipt 15 vs. 16); the parenthetical identifies the self-test, but explicitly naming that scope would avoid ambiguity.

At C0, registry-check --rev c0137451f5b7f22d65f748fc69f1b181f55e1378 from the lane root reports held=48/50, exit 1. The two active differing rows are sources-census (expect 0, got 1) and verify-round15 (expect 0, got 1). At base 981c5e8b the same two rows differ (held=47/49 across 49 active rows), so this is pre-existing tree state, not a false exit-map statement in this section. The lane-internal sources-census-v2 script reports SOURCES_CENSUS: VIOLATIONS for S280 because corpus/knowledge/scratch-root-contract.md contains neither the row id nor Errors.html; the required fleet sources-census.sh validate command separately exits 0.

The --regression SETUP-2 observation depends on repo identity: a clone without its own sibling-repository layout returns repo_identity_mismatch/SETUP 2; from the lane root with a usable TMPDIR, the regression passes 10/10. An unusable/nonexistent TMPDIR can itself make the control red and produce SETUP 2.
The registry-check command synopsis omits supported --root and --only options; the listed options are valid, so this is a completeness note rather than a false statement.
The registry-check clone-failed exit-2 arm was not independently forced; invalid-registry, unknown-rev, no-match --tag, differing-row, all-held selftest, and usage arms were exercised.
